title: Find your request: list, card, search and continuation
goal: Find the intended request and resume your own work after closing the application.

prerequisites.text: Your first saved 30-minute request and its actual number/customer are known.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: Two list rows look similar. Open the wrong one and the program can faithfully save an unintended edit. Use the actual number, customer and minutes together. Work through selection and empty search with 30/45, then check a different 20/55 pair where only one comment changes.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Use installed 1C:Enterprise. Designer is needed only to prepare the new empty target; enter cards and requests in the application. Nexus provides explanation, example, reference and your note; it neither transfers records into 1C nor observes unsaved fields. These manual tasks need no BSL or Code Studio.

sections.title: A list contains several records
paragraphs: A list is an overview; a card represents one record. A selected row does not itself mean you are editing that document. Double-click opens it; Create begins a new one. Before editing check the card’s number, date and customer. Similar comment text is insufficient identification.

Keep the first 30-minute request. Create a separate 45-minute request for your second customer using the same training service and status Новая. Record its actual number. Two distinguishable documents make a wrong selection visible.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Several documents can share a customer or comment.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

tables.caption: Select by number rather than similar text

sections.title: Search reduces the visible list
paragraphs: List search selects displayed rows; it does not delete other documents. Enter the first request’s exact number, apply search, open the result and compare its number and 30 minutes. Clear search afterwards to show both records.

For an empty result verify the relevant list rather than application-wide search, then check your infobase, number and other filters. Do not immediately create a duplicate. First establish whether the record is actually absent.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: Searching for an absent number shows zero rows. Were both requests deleted?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Search changes the visible selection. First clear search and other filters; verify the own infobase and previous numbers. Creating duplicates does not restore visibility and can corrupt records.

sections.title: Verify one change and preserve the other record
paragraphs: Find the first request by number, append проверена навигация to its comment, write and reopen. The second request must retain 45 minutes and its own comment. This checks more than a changed value in an unclosed form.

If your version offers navigation history, it may reopen a card. It is not a backup or a general undo facility. Report the route actually used: the list and number are sufficient; no universal History button is required by this lab.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Do not delete or recreate documents after an empty search. Clear conditions and verify the intended infobase first.
It begins a new document; open an existing row separately.

sections.title: Return to the same work tomorrow
paragraphs: Close your application normally, reopen the same startup entry and find the document by its saved number. Stored state must be readable independently of the preceding window. Save a semantic lesson step in Nexus; that is a learning position, not a mirror of the 1C window.

The assistant can explain instructions and recall a saved local lesson step. It does not automatically know external windows or unsaved fields. Supply an observation rather than asking it to guess. Reloading Nexus does not itself test external infobase persistence.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Preserve your first 20-minute request. Create a second for West with the same service: 55 minutes, New, another comment. Note both numbers. Find the first by number and replace only its comment with “My navigation”. Check an empty search and clearing it. After closing and restarting, compare both requests: the second must retain 55 minutes and all previous fields. Preserve the worked 30/45 pair.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author checked actual CF loading into a new own infobase, saving and renaming customers, 30/45 requests, refusal without Customer and a separate new 20/55 experiment. All four records were compared after restarting; the worked pair is preserved. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Learner actions, installer, permissions, training build 1508 and complete manual entry of every form are not verified.

paragraphs: The author checked actual CF loading into a new own infobase, saving and renaming customers, 30/45 requests, refusal without Customer and a separate new 20/55 experiment. All four records were compared after restarting; the worked pair is preserved. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you distinguish 20/55 after editing?
options: Two numbers and each record’s fields
selfcheck.feedback: After restarting I identify the first request by my own number: East, 20 minutes, New, comment “My navigation”. The other number opens West, 55 minutes and its previous service, status and comment. I create or delete no records on an empty search; clearing it makes both findable again. If I performed the 30/45 worked example, those two records remain unchanged too. Nexus stores my note and lesson step; it does not automatically observe the external 1C window.

selfcheck.prompt: How did you distinguish the selected record, unsaved input and saved result? Give your own observation and the check’s limit.
selfcheck.feedback: This free response is not graded automatically. Compare it with actual fields in your own infobase.

criteria: Name the own infobase, exact records and observations after reopening.
The new task preserves the worked example; only intended fields change.
An expected refusal is not reported as a successful save; unperformed steps are explicit.
practice.hint: No. Search changes the visible selection. First clear search and other filters; verify the own infobase and previous numbers. Creating duplicates does not restore visibility and can corrupt records.

steps.title: Second own request
steps.action: Create West’s request with your service, 55 minutes, New and a different comment. Note its number; preserve the first 20-minute request.

steps.title: Change only the first
steps.action: Open the matching row; verify its number, East and 20 minutes before editing. Change only the comment to “My navigation” and save.
steps.expected: The edit targets an exact record.

steps.title: Empty search is reversible
steps.action: Search for an absent number. Create no duplicate. Clear search and find your own numbers again.
steps.expected: The selection changed, not the documents.

steps.title: Verify after restarting
steps.action: Close your own session normally and reopen the same infobase. Read both requests and compare all fields of the second with the pre-edit note. Save the next step in Nexus.
steps.expected: 20/55 persist; no collateral edit in the second.
